verdict.rationale: Data-residency choice is a fair question for a cloud SaaS meeting assistant, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented option to choose the storage region or residency of Otter-held data. Export to a customer's Amazon S3 bucket or Google Drive sync is a related export feature, not control over where Otter stores the data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
